What we do

Pest control services

Heavy infestations, one-time emergencies or steady prevention — we build the plan around your home and your pest.

Roach Clean Outs

For heavy German roach infestations inside your house or apartment, we flush them out completely — not just the ones you can see.

Beehive Removal

Large hives removed safely — including a 50 lb. beehive inside an apartment building, with non-chemical treatment.

Bird Proofing

Sealing openings under roof eaves to prevent birds from nesting where they do not belong.

Rodent Trapping

Multiple rodent traps placed under crawl spaces to eliminate infestations under the house.

Bed Bug Treatment

Bed bug treatment using a vacuum to lift up all live bed bugs and eggs — thorough, and safe for your home.

Rodent Control

Multiple rodent boxes for exterior perimeter control — pet safe and child proof.
